integrity: The source algorithm and first-order condition were inspected directly, including the residual-reduction half-step, the extrapolated dual residual, the interpretation of 1/sigma as dual step size, and the source proof relation sigma=2/beta. The stability and tuning statements follow from exact Jury conditions and root-locus algebra; the bundled checker is supporting verification.
scientific_limitations: Exact deterministic scalar analysis of the residual-reduction and dual-update core of b-ASADMM with a decoupled y-block, theta equal to one, and a scalar positive metric. It does not extend the source stochastic convergence theorem to arbitrary sigma or cover coupled blocks, stochastic noise, theta below one, or nonconvex dynamics.
title: Sharp dual-step stability and critical damping in the residual-reduction core of b-ASADMM
